notes.title: First Month Discount
notes.content:
Special discounts started in the first month of the year. We made a special discount for you to see and experience the game. We will be with you with more content and improvements in the future.
Discounts are starting between 11-18 December!

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We fixed many things, changed some mechanics and updated game settings for better gameplay.

* The startup animation has been added.
* The problem with achievements has been fixed.
* The problem in the tutorial menu has been fixed.
* Problem with sound settings has been fixed.
* Mini optimization issues fixed.
* Some bugs have been fixed.
* Some improvements have been made based on feedback.
